expected.assertion: The source only states an industry generality, not this deployment's actual retention window. rationale: The gate's hostile half: content that invites a confident-sounding guess. Populating the field with an inference and a citation stretched to fit it is exactly the zero-tolerance failure this gate exists to catch.
